newsitem.title: USA: Iowa-S Minn fed cattle not well established - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Iowa-S Minn fed cattle not well established - USDA.

text.p: Slaughter steers and heifers were not tested, compared to Friday's close, USDA said. Trade was slow. Demand and seller interest mostly light. Offerings were light.
Steers: Select to mostly Choice 2-4 no sales.
Heifers: Select to mostly Choice 2-4 no sales.
Compared with Friday's close, slaughter steers and heifers were not well established.

Steers: Select to mostly Choice 2-4 1200-1250 lbs couple pt lds 104.00. Holstein: (weight only) Select and Choice 2-3 1250-1400 llbs no sales. Holsteins: ( grade & weight) Choice 2-3 1250-1450 lbs no sales, Select 2-3 1250-1450 lbs no sales. Heifers: Select to mostly Choice 2-4 no sales.
Wk to Date: 600 Week Ago: 900 Year Ago: 4,700
